public ActionForward execute(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form, HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws Exception

		catalogDetailAFR = (CatalogDetailAFR) form;

	public ActionForward list(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form,

	public ActionForward search(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form,
							  HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
	{
		try

			String address=request.getParameter("address");
			String root=request.getParameter("root");
			String username=request.getParameter("username");
			String serverType=request.getParameter("serverType");
			List list = catDetailSRV.getAllByCatalogId(pkDomainId,"", address,"",root,username,serverType);

	public ActionForward add(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form,
								HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
	{

		try
		{
			CatalogDetailAFR formAFR = (CatalogDetailAFR) form;
			if (request.getParameter("ok") == null)
			{
 				return new ActionForward("/jsp/general/serverAdd.jsp");
			} else {

 				CatalogDTO catalogDTO = new CatalogDTO(Long.parseLong(pkDomainId));
				ComboValuesDTO comboValuesDTO = new ComboValuesDTO(Long.parseLong(formAFR.getServerType()) ,null,null,null,null);
 				CatDetailDTO catDetailDTO = new CatDetailDTO(null,catalogDTO,null,null,
						formAFR.getTitle(),null,comboValuesDTO,EncryptionUtil.encrypt(formAFR.getPass()),formAFR.getRoot(), formAFR.getUserName());

				boolean done=catalogDetailSRV.addCatalogDetail(catDetailDTO);
				if(catDetailDTO.getStatus()!=null && catDetailDTO.getStatus().equals("0"))
				{
					catDetailDTO.setStatus("ØºÛŒØ± Ù�Ø¹Ø§Ù„");
				}
				else
					catDetailDTO.setStatus("Ù�Ø¹Ø§Ù„");
				/** *************LOG***************** */
				LogCOM.logOperations(request, "مدیریت سرور ها", "ثبت", done, catDetailDTO.getPkId() + "");
				/** *end** */
				String xmlText = XMLParserCOM.DTO2XML(catDetailDTO, done, "catDetail");
				PrintWriter out = response.getWriter();
				log.info(xmlText);
				out.print(xmlText);
				request.setAttribute("CLR", "");
				catalogDetailAFR.setAllCatalogDetailAFR("", "", "", "", "","","","");

				return null;
			}
		} catch (Exception e)
		{
			log.error("class:CatalogDetailACT.java.............function:add");
			log.error("**********" + e.getMessage() + "************");
			return null;
		}
	}

	public ActionForward edit(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form,HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
	{

		try
		{
			CatalogDetailAFR formAFR = (CatalogDetailAFR) form;

			String pkId = request.getParameter("id");

			if (request.getParameter("ok") == null)
			{
				formAFR.setAllCatalogDetailAFR(pkId, "", "", "", "","","","");
				System.out.println("############### edit #################");
				CatDetailDTO catDetailDTO = catDetailSRV.getCatalogDetail(pkId);
				String Id = catDetailDTO.getPkId().toString();

				String catalogId = catDetailDTO.getCatalogDTO().getPkCatalogId()+"";
				if (catalogId != null || catalogId == ""){
					formAFR.setCatalogId(catalogId);
				}
				String code = catDetailDTO.getCode()+"";
				if (code != null || code == ""){
					formAFR.setCode(code);
				}
				String title = catDetailDTO.getTitle();
				if (title != null || title == ""){
					formAFR.setTitle(title);
				}
				String status = catDetailDTO.getStatus();
				if (status != null || status == ""){
					formAFR.setStatus(status);
				}
				if (catDetailDTO.getServertype() != null  ){
					String serverType = catDetailDTO.getServertype().getPkComboId().toString();
					formAFR.setServerType(serverType);
				}
				String password = catDetailDTO.getServerPassword();
				if (password != null || password == ""){
					formAFR.setPass(EncryptionUtil.decrypt(password));
				}
				String root = catDetailDTO.getServerRootPath();
				if (root != null || root == ""){
					formAFR.setRoot(root);
				}
				String username = catDetailDTO.getServerUsername();
				if (username != null || username == ""){
					formAFR.setUserName(username);
				}
 				formAFR.setId(catDetailDTO.getPkId().toString());
				return new ActionForward("/jsp/general/serverEdit.jsp");
			} else
			{
				CatalogDTO catalogDTO = new CatalogDTO(Long.parseLong(pkDomainId));
				ComboValuesDTO comboValuesDTO = new ComboValuesDTO(Long.parseLong(formAFR.getServerType()) ,null,null,null,null);

				CatDetailDTO catDetailDTO = new CatDetailDTO(Long.parseLong(formAFR.getId()) ,catalogDTO,null,null,formAFR.getTitle(),null,
						comboValuesDTO,EncryptionUtil.encrypt(formAFR.getPass()),formAFR.getRoot(),formAFR.getUserName());
				boolean done = catDetailSRV.editCatalogDetail(catDetailDTO, pkId);
				if(catDetailDTO.getStatus()!=null && catDetailDTO.getStatus().equals("0"))
				{
					catDetailDTO.setStatus("ØºÛŒØ± Ù�Ø¹Ø§Ù„");
				}
				else
					catDetailDTO.setStatus("Ù�Ø¹Ø§Ù„");
				/** *************LOG***************** */
 				LogCOM.logOperations(request, "مدیریت سرور ها", ".یرایش", done, catDetailDTO.getPkId() + "");

				/** *end** */
				String xmlText = XMLParserCOM.DTO2XML(catDetailDTO, done, "catDetail");
				PrintWriter out = response.getWriter();
				log.info(xmlText);
				out.print(xmlText);
				request.setAttribute("CLR", "");
				return null;
			}
		} catch (Exception e)
		{
			log.error("class:CatalogDetailACT.java.............function:edit");
			log.error("**********" + e.getMessage() + "************");
			return null;
		}
	}

	public ActionForward delete(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form,
								HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
	{

		try
		{
			String pkId = request.getParameter("id");
			DatabaseResultCOM databaseResultCOM = catDetailSRV.removeCatalogDetail(pkId);
			if (!databaseResultCOM.isDone())
			{
				if (databaseResultCOM.getErrorType() == DatabaseResultCOM.ERROR_TYPE_CHILD_RECORD_FOUND)
				{
					request.setAttribute("msg", "delFalse");
				} else
				{
					request.setAttribute("msg", "false");
				}
			} else
			{
				request.setAttribute("msg", "true");
				/** *************LOG***************** */
				LogCOM.logOperations(request, "Ø§Ù‚Ù„Ø§Ù… Ú©Ø§ØªØ§Ù„ÙˆÚ¯", "Ø­Ø°Ù�", true, pkId);
				/** *end** */
			}
			request.setAttribute("CLR", "");
			return list(mapping, form, request, response);
		} catch (Exception e)
		{
			log.error("class:CatalogDetailACT.java.............function:delete");
			log.error("**********" + e.getMessage() + "************");
			return null;
		}
	}
	public String dhtmlxGrid(ActionMapping mapping, ActionForm form,
			HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) {
		try {
			response.setContentType("text/xml");
			List<CatDetailDTO> list = catDetailSRV.getAllCatalogDetail("SERVERLIST", "", "");
			String gridString = "<rows>\r\n";
			int i = 1;
			for (CatDetailDTO catDetailDTO : list) {

				gridString += "	<row id=\"" + catDetailDTO.getPkId() + "\">\r\n";
				gridString += "		<cell>" + i + "</cell>\r\n";
				gridString += "		<cell>0</cell>\r\n";
				gridString += "		<cell>" + catDetailDTO.getTitle() + "</cell>\r\n";
				gridString += "	</row>";
				i++;
			}
			gridString += "	</rows>";
			PrintWriter out = response.getWriter();
			out.print(gridString);
			out.close();
			response.flushBuffer();
			return null;
		} catch (Exception e) {
			// TODO: handle exception
			e.printStackTrace();
			return null;
		}
		
	}
